Prices include taxes. Ask us about dairy-free milk and today's specials.

We wanted a place that tastes like home: strong tea, good coffee and something warm from the oven.

Mistleaf started with one counter, one espresso machine and our grandmother's love cake recipe. Today we buy tea straight from small estates in Nuwara Eliya and Uva, and roast with a local roaster in the hills.

Come for a quick cup, stay for the afternoon. There's always a table by the window.

  • Single-estate Ceylon tea
  • Locally roasted coffee
  • Baked every morning
  • Free Wi-Fi

Inside Mistleaf

Window seats, the smell of fresh bread and a pot of tea that never seems to end.

Come and visit

Find us a short walk from Kandy Lake. Drop in for a cup, or email us to book a table for a group.
